description: This file defines a PHP class that extends the ViewQuickEdit class to customize the quick edit functionality for the Users module in SuiteCRM. It specifies a footer template for record reassignment during user status changes and sets default button configurations.

classes.name: UsersViewQuickedit
classes.description: A class extending ViewQuickEdit, customized for the Users module's quick edit view with additional footer template and default buttons.

methods.name: footerTpl
methods.description: String variable holding the path to the Smarty footer template file for quick edit, allowing for record reassignment functionality.

methods.name: defaultButtons
methods.description: Array of default buttons for the quick edit form, including cancel and full form options, with custom save button integration.
